## How this list is made

- **Sources.** Roles come from the public job APIs behind company career sites (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and a few others). We track {{TRACKED}} companies; the ones listed here have at least one open PhD internship today.
- **What counts.** A role is listed when it is an internship and the posting says a PhD is required or preferred. Each job description is classified by an LLM, and rule-based filters check the result. If you spot a misclassified role, see [Corrections](#corrections).
- **Freshness.** Career pages are checked several times a day, and this page is rebuilt once a day. A role drops off when the company closes the posting.
- **Hiring posts.** The posts listed here come from people on the hiring team. Posts from staffing agencies are left out.

## Corrections

Found a closed role, a wrong degree label or a company we should add? [Open an issue](../../issues/new/choose) with the link, or email harry@cookllm.com. This README is generated every day, so pull requests to it would be overwritten; we fix the underlying data instead, and the fix shows up in the next update.

This list is not affiliated with or endorsed by any company on it. Postings change; check the company's page before you apply.
